name: ai.bringyour/bringyour
registry_description: No-data MCP handoff for local Claude Code to Codex harness moves. $49 lifetime.

tools.description: Free no-data preview for moving a harness between any two of the 13 supported tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw, Aider, Continue, Cline, Goose, Zed, Roo Code, ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Copilot). Returns feasibility copy only. Does not accept or return mappings, file paths, generated content, or validation notes.

from.description: Source tool id, e.g. claude-code, cursor, codex, openclaw, aider, continue, cline, goose, zed, roo, chatgpt, claude-ai. Use list_targets for the full matrix.

to.description: Target tool id, e.g. codex, cursor, claude-code, copilot. Use list_targets for the full matrix.

tools.name: preview_move

tools.description: Free no-data preview for building a user's first setup in any of the 13 supported tools. Does not accept GitHub handles, generated memories, mappings, or file content.

to.description: Target tool id, e.g. claude-code, codex, cursor. Use list_targets for the full matrix.

tools.name: preview_build_setup

tools.description: List Bring Your AI target tools. No harness data is accepted or returned.
tools.name: list_targets

tools.description: Return no-data local install and MCP wiring commands. The remote server does not install anything and does not receive harness data.
tools.name: install_local_cli

tools.description: List agent-readable Bring Your AI products and supported payment modes. No harness data is accepted.
tools.name: list_products

tools.description: Quote a Bring Your AI lifetime license in USD. Human checkout uses Stripe Payment Links; agent checkout can settle a Link-issued Stripe shared payment token.

currency.description: Optional requested currency. Only USD is currently supported.

product_id.description: Optional product id. Defaults to bringyour_founder_lifetime.

tools.name: quote_lifetime_license

tools.description: Start checkout. With payment_mode=stripe_spt plus shared_payment_granted_token and buyer_email, settles a Stripe PaymentIntent and returns the signed license without opening a browser.

buyer_email.description: Email bound to the issued license. Required for stripe_spt settlement.

payment_mode.description: stripe_payment_link, stripe_link, link, stripe_checkout, stripe_acp, stripe_spt, or x402.

product_id.description: Optional product id. Defaults to bringyour_founder_lifetime.

shared_payment_granted_token.description: Link-issued Stripe shared payment token. Required for stripe_spt settlement.

tools.name: start_checkout
